Edition record 371399 · p. 160Link to report ↗
475
Report from Ibn Zalim No. 475: 7: 10

Ibn Zalim

English
Transmission wording
475: 7:10. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Hilal ibn Yasaf, from Ibn Zalim, who said:
A man came to Said ibn Zayd and said, "I loved a man of the people of Paradise" [the sentence is garbled]; he said, "I have hated Uthman as I have never hated anyone." He said, "What you have done is evil. You have hated a man of the people of Paradise." Then he began a narration and said: We were with the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, on Hira, and he mentioned these ten and said, "Be still, Hira, for on you are only a prophet, a siddiq, and a martyr."
العربية
475: 7: 10 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يساف عن بن ظَالِمٍ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ قال ابغضت عُثْمَانَ بُغْضًا لَمْ أَبْغَضْهُ أَحَدًا قَطُّ قَالَ بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعْتَ أَبَغَضْتَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ حَدِيثًا فَقَالَ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى حِرَاءَ الذي فَذَكَرَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْعَشْرَةَ فَقَالَ اثْبُتْ حِرَاءُ. فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ نَبِيٌّ وَصِدِّيقٌ وشهيدا.

“[What of] the words of God 'as We sent down upon the…”

An explanation transmitted from Abu Zabyan (Q 15:90).

479
Explanation from Abu Zabyan No. 479: 11: 11

Abu Zabyan

English
Transmission wording
479: 11:11. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu Zabyan, who said:
A man came to Ibn Abbas and said, "[What of] the words of God 'as We sent down upon the dividers' [muqtasimin]? Who are the dividers?" He said, the Jews and the Christians, "who made the Qur'an into parts [idin]." "What are the idin?" ⦗p. 162⦘ He said, they believed in part of it and disbelieved in part of it (verse 90).

الإسناد
